data.exact_reserve_text: Included within net claims incurred in the Technical Account - General Business is a release of GBP 36,839,000 (2013: strengthening of GBP 2,107,000) being the difference between the provision for claims outstanding at the beginning of the year less payments made during the year on account of claims incurred in previous years and the provision for claims outstanding at the end of the year for such claims. The net release in 2014 was the result of favourable development on prior year catastrophe and attritional losses, in particular on reinsurance segments, offsetting deterioration in the estimated ultimate Motor liabilities.
data.standardized_narrative: The Syndicate reports a net release in respect of prior years of GBP 36.839m (net of reinsurance), driven by favourable development on prior year catastrophe and attritional losses (particularly within reinsurance segments), partially offset by deterioration in Motor ultimate liabilities. Opening gross claims outstanding at 1 January 2014 were GBP 2,244.4m, so the reported net release represents approximately a 1.6% reduction relative to opening gross reserves. A gross prior-year movement figure is not presented in the notes; the quantified release is reported net of reinsurance.
raw_causal_phrases: Included within net claims incurred in the Technical Account - General Business is a release of GBP 36,839,000 (2013: strengthening of GBP 2,107,000) being the difference between the provision for claims outstanding at the beginning of the year less payments made during the year on account of claims incurred in previous years and the provision for claims outstanding at the end of the year for such claims.

The net release in 2014 was the result of favourable development on prior year catastrophe and attritional losses, in particular on reinsurance segments, offsetting deterioration in the estimated ultimate Motor liabilities.
favourable development on prior years for both direct and assumed Aviation lines and Property classes contributed significantly, whilst Motor continued to prove challenging.
the Syndicate's claims ratio improved to 58% (2013: 62%), reflecting a below average Atlantic hurricane season, but an unusually high incidence of Aviation claims.
data.data_quality_notes: Opening gross claims outstanding taken from Balance Sheet (Technical provisions - Claims outstanding, prior-year column). No gross 'movement in prior year's provision' or gross claims development triangle was found in the disclosed notes; the only quantified prior year movement shown in the notes is a net release of GBP 36,839,000 (net of reinsurance). Accordingly prior_year_development_gbp_m uses the NET figure (flagged as net of reinsurance). No detailed triangle or per-LOB quantified prior-year movements were provided; LOB directions are inferred from narrative only.
